svg.text: Vuka Ride — colour system and patterns
Deep and living greens for trust and growth, with sunrise orange and gold as the accent. Mostly green and white; orange and gold stay around 10%.
Primary. Buttons, links, app chrome, gradients.
Accent. 'Ride' in the wordmark, highlights, icons.
Accent. The sun, badges, 'Ride' on dark.
Light green text on dark, soft
Tint and shade scales (500, 700 and 900 are brand anchors)
Roughly: 40% deep green, 30% white and mist, 20% Vuka green,
and only about 10% orange and gold. The orange is the spark,
so use it for the sun, 'Ride', calls to action and badges.
Gradient: Vuka Green to Forest Night at 135° (app icon, splash).
Note: orange text on white is only fine for large or bold text. For small text on white use Deep Green.
Patterns (all seamless; tiles and swatches are in the patterns folder)
